clue.text: Not liable to include member in river trip, initially

indicators.note: the river-and-trip string is made to include another piece within it

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, a crossword regular

indicators.note: initially signals that only the opening letter of trip is used

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Someone avoids liability by bringing a politician along on a river outing.
explanation.walkthrough: EXE plus T (first letter of 'trip') makes EXET; 'to include' puts MP inside it, between EXE and T.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone exempt is free from an obligation or duty, so not liable for it.

clue.text: The service is, nevertheless, no good

parts.note: even so means nevertheless

explanation.surface: A grumble that a church service is, all the same, worthless.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is the Anglican evening prayer service.

clue.text: Writer has quietly turned out song, producing delight

indicators.note: turned out means evicted, so the quiet letter is dropped from the writer

parts.note: a pen is a writing implement
P, piano, is the musical mark for quietly
a chant is a song or sung refrain

explanation.surface: An author quietly produces a song that gives pleasure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned out': PEN loses P, leaving EN.
explanation.definitionFit: To charm or captivate someone is to give them delight.

clue.text: I had to interrupt tense chief executive

indicators.note: to interrupt means to break into the middle of the tense word

parts.note: present is a grammatical tense
I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: Someone cuts into a nervous boss's meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tense' looks like an adjective about the boss but is the grammatical tense.
explanation.definitionFit: A president heads a company or state as its top official.

clue.text: Bad coach's marginalized position in theatre

parts.note: food that has gone off is bad
a stage, as in stagecoach, is a horse-drawn coach

explanation.surface: A poor sports coach is pushed to the sidelines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coach' suggests a sports trainer but is the old horse-drawn stagecoach.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the wings, out of the audience's view, is being pushed to the edge of the theatre.

clue.text: Mad Hatter's top form, generally

indicators.note: mad suggests letters thrown into a crazy disorder

explanation.surface: The Mad Hatter of Alice in Wonderland is usually at his best.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mad' reads as part of the Mad Hatter's name, but it is the signal to rearrange HATTERSTOPFORM.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something is mostly so means it is true on the whole, in most cases.

clue.text: Bags an instrument, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: a sax is a saxophone

explanation.surface: Someone grabs a musical instrument, for example.
explanation.definitionFit: Bags are large sacks, and as verbs both mean grabbing or securing something.

clue.text: A requirement one's admitted for flavouring

indicators.note: admitted means taken inside, so the requirement word lets the other piece in

parts.note: a need is a requirement
one is I, and one's is read as I'S

explanation.surface: Someone admits that one thing is needed for a flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: The seed of the anise plant is used to give a liquorice taste to food and drinks.

clue.text: Pass freely, please

indicators.note: freely suggests the letters may roam about into a new order

explanation.surface: A polite request to let someone go by without hindrance.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that passes is said to go by, as in weeks going by.

clue.text: Altruistic inn landlord originally chilled drink in it

parts.note: a pub is an inn

indicators.note: originally points to the first letter of landlord
in it says the drink goes inside the chilled word

parts.note: iced means chilled
a spirit is a strong alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: A generous innkeeper first chills a drink with something added.
explanation.definitionFit: Unselfish devotion to the community's good is what altruism means.

clue.text: Private funds building former PM's country house, mostly

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: mostly means all but the final letter of the house name

parts.note: Chequers is the British Prime Minister's country residence in Buckinghamshire

explanation.surface: A private fortune pays for a building at an ex-prime minister's country home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'building' is a link word, not a construction.
explanation.definitionFit: Humorously, a person's own finances or purse are their own treasury.

clue.text: Man leaves special delivery for mate

indicators.note: leaves means goes away from the longer word, so those letters are dropped

parts.note: a chinaman is an unusual left-arm spinner's delivery in cricket
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man walks away from a courier's special delivery meant for his friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'special delivery' sounds like postage; it is a cricket ball. 'China' for mate is Cockney rhyming slang: china plate = mate.
explanation.definitionFit: In Cockney rhyming slang, a china (plate) is a pal.

clue.text: Dog that's left by bridge

parts.note: a span is a bridge or the stretch it crosses
i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A dog that has been abandoned beside a bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' looks like a relative pronoun but gives IE, Latin for 'that is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A spaniel is a breed of gundog with long ears.

clue.text: Eastern vessel used by old army entertainer

parts.note: host is an archaic word for an army
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: An oriental ship is used by a former military entertainer.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who receives and looks after guests is the person entertaining them.

clue.text: Employed in kitchen, it requires salt

indicators.note: employed in means the letters are used within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A recipe in the kitchen calls for salt.
explanation.definitionFit: Saltpetre, potassium nitrate, is a salt used in curing meat.

clue.text: Shock troops also invading a lot of public land

indicators.note: invading means one piece pushes its way into the other
a lot of means most of the word, its last letter dropped

parts.note: a common is land open to the public
and means also

explanation.surface: Special forces also seize much of the public grounds.
explanation.definitionFit: A commando unit is an elite force trained for raids, the shock troops of an army.

clue.text: Outside university an emotional attachment is flourishing

parts.note: an gives the letter A

indicators.note: outside means the attachment words go around the university letter

parts.note: bonding is an emotional attachment formed between people

explanation.surface: A relationship blossoms off campus.
explanation.definitionFit: Existing in great plenty is what thriving or flourishing growth suggests.

clue.text: Protective coating left out for submarine

indicators.note: out means the left letter is taken out of the coating

parts.note: underseal is an anti-rust coating for a car's underside

explanation.surface: A rust-proof coating left off a submarine.
explanation.definitionFit: Submarine as an adjective means located below the sea's surface.

clue.text: Creature that's odd — and then some! A sort mostly found in the interior

indicators.note: found in the interior says these pieces sit inside the other

parts.note: plus means and then some, more besides

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter of the word for sort is dropped

parts.note: a type is a sort or kind

explanation.surface: An odd creature with a type mostly seen in the outback.
explanation.definitionFit: The duck-billed, egg-laying mammal of Australia is famously strange.

clue.text: Managing to get breathing-space between flights

definitions.meaning: ... a job or a fish means securing it
the platform between flights of stairs

explanation.definitionFit: Landing means securing something, and also the level area between stairs.

clue.text: Gold brooch in the form of a plant

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
a pin is a brooch or ornamental fastener

explanation.surface: A gold brooch shaped like a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Orpine is a stonecrop, a succulent plant, also spelt this shorter way.

clue.text: Act as trail-blazer i.e. open region initially wild

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters run riot into a new order
initially means the first letter of region

explanation.surface: An explorer opens up untamed territory.
explanation.definitionFit: To lead the way into new ground is to blaze a trail for others.

clue.text: Hit and carried out robbery

definitions.meaning: to swipe is to strike with a sweeping blow
to swipe is informal for to steal

explanation.definitionFit: Swiped means both struck with a swinging blow and stole.

clue.text: Where royalty relaxes and soldiers put on airs

indicators.note: put on means placed after the other piece

parts.note: winds are moving airs, currents of air
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Royals unwind as troops show off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'airs' suggests showing off but gives WINDS. 'and' is a link. Windsor Castle is a residence of the British monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Windsor Castle is a favoured home of the British royal family.

clue.text: Rosemary, for one, is cordial

definitions.meaning: rosemary is a bushy herb, a woody garden plant
a cordial made of fruit juice, sugar and spirit or vinegar

explanation.definitionFit: Shrub is both a woody bush, like rosemary, and an old fruit drink.

clue.text: Hurry back to mean dwelling, getting small puncture

indicators.note: back means the word for hurry is read backwards

parts.note: to nip is to hurry somewhere quickly
a hole is a squalid, cramped home

explanation.surface: Someone rushes home to a hovel and finds a tiny leak.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny hole made by a pin is a small puncture.

clue.text: Poet superior to his brothers

definitions.meaning: Matthew ... was an English poet and diplomat
a monastery's second-in-command ranks above the monks, his brothers

explanation.definitionFit: Matthew Prior was a poet; a prior is a senior monk over the brethren.

clue.text: Slow progress made by sailors consuming banquets

indicators.note: consuming means swallowing the banquet word inside

parts.note: tars are sailors
dines means feasts, eats a meal

explanation.surface: Sailors eating lavish meals are slow to move on.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateness and sluggishness are what tardiness means.

clue.text: Menial servant Pluto was provided with

definitions.meaning: a drudge who does the dull jobs

explanation.definitionFit: A drudge is called a dogsbody; Pluto the cartoon dog has a dog's body.

clue.text: Source of good advice, for example, I located in time

parts.note: eg means for example

indicators.note: located in means placed inside the time word

parts.note: an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A good adviser, for instance, finds themselves in a certain period.
explanation.walkthrough: Egeria was the nymph who advised the Roman king Numa.
explanation.definitionFit: An Egeria is a female adviser or counsellor, after the nymph.
